guide.summary: Temples, shrines, a castle, museums, a botanical garden, Nishiki Market, kaiseki and tofu dinners, kissaten, bakeries, coffee and hotel bars, each checked against its own website.
guide.tip: Check closing days before you go: Kyoto National Museum and Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art close on Mondays, Tenryu-ji is closed on October 29 and 30, 2026, and Kikunoi Honten closes on the first and third Tuesdays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Kyoto National Museum closes on Mondays, and Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art closes on Mondays except public holidays. Kikunoi Honten closes on the first and third Tuesdays, Omen Ginkakuji Main Store has irregular Thursday closures, and Ippodo's Kyoto Main Store closes on the 2nd Wednesday.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: Kyoto National Museum says advance tickets aren't required for The Tale of Genji (October 6 to November 29, 2026). Kitano Tenmangu's Momiji Garden (October 31 to December 6, 2026) costs 1,500 yen for adults and 700 yen for children.

toolkit.label: Booking and walk-ins
toolkit.copy: Kikunoi Honten takes reservations by phone or through MY CONCIERGE and TABLE ALL, and Omen asks you to phone each store because it doesn't accept email bookings. Francois Kissa takes no reservations and is cash only.

toolkit.label: House rules
toolkit.copy: Francois Kissa doesn't admit children under school age, may set time limits when crowded and may refuse large luggage. Tenryu-ji says its buildings are occasionally closed without notice for special ceremonies.

guide.dek: Build your days around fixed closing days and the late-autumn night openings, and book Kyoto's kaiseki dinners well ahead.
intro: Kyoto's temples set their own calendars this autumn. Kiyomizu-dera opens at 6:00 a.m. and lists a special night viewing from November 21 to 30, 2026, open until 9:30 PM. Ginkaku-ji opens from 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. through November 30 and holds an autumn special viewing from November 1 to December 5, 2026. Kinkaku-ji opens from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., and a September 2026 notice says you can pay cashless at its admission desk. In Arashiyama, Tenryu-ji opens from 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., but it is closed on October 29 and 30, 2026.

At Toji, the first floor of the Five-Storied Pagoda opens specially from October 31 to December 13, 2026, with an autumn light-up and night admission to the Kondo and Kodo on the same dates. Its Treasure House exhibition runs until November 25. Kitano Tenmangu's gate opens from 7:00 to 17:00, and its Momiji Garden runs from October 31 to December 6, with evening illumination from November 13. Yasaka Shrine's office is staffed from 9:00 to 17:00. Fushimi Inari Taisha publishes no hours and asks you to come by public transport because parking nearby is very crowded.

Kyoto National Museum's special exhibition, The Tale of Genji: Radiant Culture of the Japanese Imperial Court, runs October 6 to November 29, 2026, and you don't need an advance ticket. The museum closes on Mondays. In Okazaki, Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art opens from 10:00 to 18:00 and shows Zen and Ghibli until December 6. The National Museum of Modern Art, Kyoto shows Reflections in Jewellery: Memory and Identity until January 17. Nijo Castle admits visitors from 8:45 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. and has shortened hours on December 6, 2026.

For an early start, Inoda Coffee Main Store opens at 7:00 every day and serves morning coffee and breakfast. Sizuya's Kyoto Station shop also opens at 7:00, and Le Petit Mec's Imadegawa shop opens at 8:00. Francois Kissa takes cash only and no reservations. For dinner, Kikunoi Honten closes on the first and third Tuesdays, and Nanzenji Junsei takes last dinner orders at 19:00. Omen's Ginkakuji Main Store serves dinner from Friday to Sunday and on holidays. For drinks, Ace Hotel Kyoto has Mr. Maurice's Rooftop Bar, and Hotel The Mitsui Kyoto has The Garden Bar.
summaryCards: Pair Kiyomizu-dera with Kyoto National Museum's Genji exhibition (to November 29, 2026), but not on a Monday, when the museum is closed.
Start at Inoda Coffee Main Store, which opens at 7:00 every day, then walk to Nishiki Market or Ippodo's Kaboku Tearoom, which opens at 10:00.
Avoid Tenryu-ji on October 29 and 30, 2026, Kikunoi Honten on the first and third Tuesdays, and Ippodo's Kyoto Main Store on the 2nd Wednesday.

limitations: This is a website review, not a visit or a phone check. Published opening, booking and exhibition details don't guarantee availability. Several official sites couldn't be read: Kyoto Imperial Palace (maintenance notice), Sanjusangen-do and Ryoan-ji (certificate or SSL errors), Heian Jingu and Shinshindo (connection refused), Hyotei, Kagizen Yoshifusa and Smart Coffee (502 errors), Four Seasons and Park Hyatt Kyoto (403), % Arabica (418), Kyoto Railway Museum and Shimogamo Shrine (no readable content), and Kyoto Aquarium's access page (timed out). Kinkaku-ji's only dated 2026 item is a September 28 cashless-payment notice. Hours weren't published or readable for Fushimi Inari Taisha, Nishiki Market, Toji, the National Museum of Modern Art, Weekenders Coffee, Stumptown Coffee, Mr. Maurice's Rooftop Bar and The Garden Bar. Yasaka Shrine lists only its office hours. Sizuya and Ippodo rest on company-wide 2026 notices, and Le Petit Mec's address is an English rendering from its shop list.
